requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: The requirement 'Generate a dial tone' is resolved using the controlled context constraint CST-01, which defines the dial tone as a simultaneous 350 Hz and 440 Hz signal per the North American telephony standard.

fields.condition: System is operating within the North American telephony standard environment.

structured_requirements.final_statement: The Telephony Exchange System shall generate a dial tone signal consisting of simultaneous 350 Hz and 440 Hz frequencies.
structuring_notes: Ambiguity regarding the definition of 'dial tone' was resolved by applying constraint CST-01 from the controlled context.
The functional template was applied to the resolved interpretation of generating specific frequency components.
